_readme: Rule-based phrasing templates for Screen Time insights. No LLM call — pick a category by the deterministic thresholds already computed in code, then pick one template at random (or rotate) from that category's array, then substitute {placeholders}. Re-roll only changes wording, never the underlying numbers. Keep one chosen variant stable for a given child+day (cache the choice, don't re-roll on every screen open, so the same insight doesn't visibly change wording mid-session.

trend._thresholds: up_significant: >+20% vs prior period. up_slight: +5% to +20%. stable: -5% to +5%. down_slight: -5% to -20%. down_significant: <-20%.

weekdayPattern._thresholds: weekday_high: 1-2 weekdays running >25% above the child's daily average, in >=3 of the last weekCount weeks. weekend_high: same check but for Sat/Sun as a pair. Omit entirely if no weekday clears this bar.
